correctness.rationale: For any m>=2 positive weighted star, grounding a center leader leaves diagonal follower block with cost sum_{unselected leaves}1/w_i; optimum selects k-1 weakest spokes. With center follower, Schur complement is W=sum leader conductances and trace is sum_{unselected}1/w_i+(m-k+1)/W. For any leaf-only set selecting b>a while smaller a is unselected, either center substitution strictly lowers cost if sum selected <(m-k+1)b or swapping b to a strictly lowers cost otherwise; this proves one of two candidates is globally optimal. Comparing costs yields A_k-B_k=1/w_k-(m-k+1)/P_k and the advertised sharp threshold for 1<=k<=m, with k=m+1 cost zero. For w=(1 five times,100 three times), exact Fraction exhaustive checks give k=5 cost83/100, k=6 cost3/100, k=7 cost81/4100 and every optimizer of these budgets excludes/includes/excludes center respectively (k=7 has three tied optimal sets, not a unique set). Finite enumeration supplements the all-weights dominance proof.
